reason: I already paste German and Polish messages into ChatGPT at midnight, so if they set it up and I can try it first, I'd put it on one apartment and see if the WhatsApp questions drop. Because I can pause it in winter, it's not a full-year bill, but I'm not putting all my units on it until I see it work.
objection: With four or five apartments it's €35 each plus €150 setup each, and that adds up fast for something that only really works June to September. Also, if it tells a guest something wrong about parking or check-in, I'm the one who gets the bad review.
would_change_my_mind: If the setup fee were one fee for all my apartments, or there was a lower price per unit from the second apartment, I'd move all of them over instead of just one.
